purpose: Original editorial illustrations for the Solo Vibe Coding website; not screenshots or evidence of completed case outcomes.

assets.name: hero
assets.prompt: Create a premium art-directed 3D product still-life for a bold independent-developer software website. Physically plausible polished chrome, translucent colored glass, matte ceramic, crisp studio lighting and refined material reflections. A coherent expressive design world with electric cobalt blue #2457F5, warm tangerine #FF784F, acid lime #D5F36B and silver. Isolated on a genuinely transparent background, complete objects inside the canvas with generous margins. No text, no letters, no logos, no people, no fake screenshot, no watermark. This is an editorial illustration, not a functional product interface. Landscape composition for a large website hero: a monumental sculptural polished-chrome ribbon threads through three floating rounded browser-window-shaped cobalt glass frames, with one tangerine ceramic sphere and a small lime glass block orbiting the assembly. Asymmetrical, sculptural, tangible and playful like a contemporary design exhibition photographed with a macro lens. One unmistakable coherent focal sculpture. Dramatic depth, subtle soft contact shadows, no ground plane. High visual sophistication, not an icon pack. Leave breathing room around the silhouette.
